QuestInfo.name: The Culprit Among Us
QuestInfo.0: Something big has happened at the training grounds last night! Go speak with No Gong and find out what happened.
QuestInfo.1: Someone had eaten some meat in the pharmacy last night and left a mess. Meat is forbidden to trainees who are training to become a master. No Gong wants you to find out which trainee was the culprit.
QuestInfo.2: Alpha and Beta heard from Lilishu that she saw Mu Tan enter the pharmacy on the eve of the crime.

speech.0: I heard from No Gong. I take care of the pharmacy, but I forgot to lock the doors last night. It was probably around 9 when I got out.  I don't remember anything, except that I ran into #rMr. Gong#k on my way.
Was I at the Pharmacy yesterday? Yeah, I needed some medicine to fight off this cold. But Mr. Do was already gone, so I gave up and went to bed early.
speech.1: Did I see anyone? Um, let's see... #rDalsuk#k was running off somewhere... I asked her what's up, but she ignored me.

speech.0: L-last night? I'm trying to watch what I eat, but I got so hungry that I... I ate all the #bKuzu Vine Roots#k at the pharmacy! I wanted to chew on something...  Meat? No, I haven't even looked at meat in awhile...
speech.1: Did I see someone at the Pharmacy? Hm... I did see #rLan Ming#k on my way out. He jumped when he saw me. He must've wanted Kuzu Vine Roots, like me.

speech.0: What did I do at the Pharmacy last night? Somebody saw me, huh? It's true. I'm actually... Dating #rLilishu#k. We tried to be discreet, but now the secret is out...
That's right... I was with #bLan Ming#k last night. We thought it'd be isolated, but we were wrong. I saw #rMu Tan#k heading inside as we were leaving.

0.0: This is unbelievable! Never before have we seen such a thing. Our trainees are forbidden from eating meat, you see. Meat clouds your mind with thoughts of anger, violence, and barbecue sauce.
0.1: And yet here we have definite proof. Bones and bits of meat. We can't just let this slide! We must find who ate them. Could you help?

yes.0: It must be one of the trainees. Will you go ask them what they did? Secretively?

no.0: I guess I can just call all the trainees for an interrogation.

default.0: I was so tired last night, I fell asleep at the dinner table. Noodles all over my face!

npc.0: Go get whoever would dare to commit the atrocious act of eating meat in Mu Lung.
